description: Backend audit findings and resolutions from Spectre AI Developer Control. Claude uses this to avoid repeating backend issues in new code.

rules.rule: Never introduce: 36 vercel functions allow all origins (cors *)
rules.resolution: Applied automatically via Developer Control (31 files changed)

rules.rule: Never introduce: 15 external fetch calls without timeout
Never introduce: 5 vercel functions allow all origins (cors *)
rules.resolution: Applied automatically via Developer Control (5 files changed)

openIssues.issue: 2 routes: query param passed to fetch unsanitized
openIssues.recommendation: Use encodeURIComponent() on all query params before passing to external APIs.
Add authentication middleware to sensitive routes (AI, user, swap, admin).

openIssues.issue: 2 POST/PUT/DELETE routes without visible auth check
openIssues.recommendation: Add auth middleware or token verification to all mutation routes.

openIssues.issue: Content store may write files with unsanitized names
Swap route may accept negative or zero amounts
openIssues.recommendation: Validate: amount > 0, amount <= maxAllowed, and amount is a valid number (not NaN/Infinity).
Wrap all async route handlers in try/catch with res.status(500).json({ error }) fallback.
Apply rate limiting middleware to AI and expensive compute routes.
Add IP-based rate limiting or use Vercel Edge Config for rate control.

openIssues.issue: 9 routes: req.body used without type check
openIssues.recommendation: Validate req.body shape and types before processing. Check for null/undefined.
Create Vercel serverless functions for production-critical routes, or document as dev-only.
Use Promise.all([fetch(...), fetch(...)]) for independent external API calls.
Extract route groups into separate files under packages/server/routes/.

openIssues.issue: 2 files pass user input to LLM without sanitization
openIssues.recommendation: Use a sanitizer (see agents/querySanitizer.js) to strip injection patterns before passing user text to LLM APIs.

openIssues.issue: 2 LLM-calling files have no system prompt
openIssues.recommendation: Always include a system role message that defines boundaries and expected behavior.

openIssues.issue: 1 sensitive Vercel functions may skip auth verification
openIssues.recommendation: Import and call verifyToken from _lib/auth.js at the start of every sensitive handler.

openIssues.issue: 4 files use dynamic values in file paths
openIssues.recommendation: Validate: 1) path.basename() to strip slashes, 2) regex to allow only [a-zA-Z0-9_-], 3) verify resolved path is within expected directory.

openIssues.issue: 3 files apply complex regex to user input
openIssues.recommendation: Add input length limits. Simplify regex. Use string methods for simple matching.

openIssues.issue: 78 files have complex regex on trusted data
openIssues.recommendation: Low priority. Consider simplifying if these files ever process user input.
